paper_record.title: Why polar excitons stay sharp: parity protection of the center-of-mass recoil channel in exciton-phonon scattering
paper_record.abstract: In polar semiconductors the Fröhlich interaction is the dominant electron--phonon coupling, yet excitonic resonances in materials such as halide perovskites remain anomalously sharp. We show that standard frozen-center-of-mass treatments of the exciton--phonon problem miss the decisive kinematic degree of freedom: restoring the exact center-of-mass (COM) recoil reveals a universally open, parameter-free $1s\to1s$ absorption channel at recoil momentum $q_*=\sqrt{2M_{\rm ex}\hbarω_{\rm LO}}/\hbar$, whose rate scales as $N_{\rm LO}(T)$. We prove that this recoil channel is controlled by destructive electron--hole interference: the recoil linewidth vanishes with the mass asymmetry as $γ_{\rm LO}^{\rm recoil}\propto\mathcal{F}_{1s,1s}(q_*)^2$, and the elastic dressing obeys the exact suppression law $S_X/S_{\rm ind}=η^2(6-η^2)/5$ within the hydrogenic Fröhlich model. The theory establishes a hierarchy of scattering regimes. In mass-asymmetric materials (GaAs, $η=-0.74$) the recoil channel is active ($γ_{\rm LO}^{\rm recoil}=2.2$~meV); in mass-symmetric materials (FAPbI$_3$, $η=0$; MAPbI$_3$, $η=-0.11$) it is killed by interference (0.00 and 0.12 meV), showing that the observed 27--40 meV perovskite linewidths cannot be accounted for by COM recoil and therefore require internal-state-changing and other inelastic channels, of which the constructive, $η$-robust $1s\to np$ resonance is the leading candidate within the present model. The Fröhlich constant $α$ alone is therefore insufficient as a figure of merit: after projection onto the correlated exciton, the controlling parameters are $η$, $q_*a_X$, and the Rydberg detuning.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 本文揭示了激子-声子散射中质心反冲通道的宇称保护机制，解释了极性半导体中激子线宽为何保持尖锐。
one_sentence_summary.en: This paper reveals a parity-protection mechanism for the center-of-mass recoil channel in exciton-phonon scattering, explaining why excitonic resonances remain sharp in polar semiconductors.

problem.zh: 传统理论无法解释卤化物钙钛矿等材料在强电子-声子耦合下为何仍表现出异常尖锐的激子线宽。
problem.en: Standard theories fail to explain why materials like halide perovskites exhibit anomalously sharp excitonic linewidths despite strong electron-phonon coupling.

approach.zh: 通过恢复激子质心运动的动力学自由度，推导了激子-声子散射的宇称选择定则，并分析了质量不对称性对散射通道的影响。
approach.en: By restoring the kinematic degrees of freedom of the exciton center-of-mass, the authors derive parity selection rules for exciton-phonon scattering and analyze the impact of mass asymmetry on scattering channels.

main_takeaway.zh: 激子质心反冲通道受宇称保护，在质量对称材料中被完全抑制；激子线宽主要由内部态跃迁（如1s到np）而非质心反冲决定。
main_takeaway.en: The exciton center-of-mass recoil channel is parity-protected and vanishes in mass-symmetric materials; excitonic linewidths are primarily governed by internal-state-changing transitions (e.g., 1s to np) rather than center-of-mass recoil.

why_it_matters.zh: 该研究证明了弗勒利希常数不足以作为衡量激子-声子散射的唯一指标，并为设计相干光电材料提供了新的物理判据。
why_it_matters.en: The study demonstrates that the Fröhlich constant is insufficient as a sole metric for exciton-phonon scattering and provides new physical criteria for designing coherent optoelectronic materials.

reason.zh: 通过解析模型澄清了激子线宽保持尖锐的物理机制，并纠正了对质心反冲通道的传统认识。
reason.en: The paper clarifies the physical mechanism behind sharp excitonic linewidths using analytical models and corrects traditional misconceptions regarding the center-of-mass recoil channel.

reason.zh: 该论文侧重于凝聚态物理中激子-声子相互作用的解析理论推导，符合PRB的发表范畴。
reason.en: The paper focuses on analytical theoretical derivations of exciton-phonon interactions in condensed matter physics, which fits the scope of PRB.
